sentences.text: Linyiornis is an extinct bird genus placed in the family Bohaiornithidae. It is monotypic, known only from the single species Linyiornis amoena.
Scientists Wang and colleagues formally described this genus in 2016.
Fossils of Linyiornis date to the Early Cretaceous period in China. The animal lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
